findings.evidence: For systems administration and troubleshooting, we log the IP address (the location on the Internet) of the computer or network from which someone visits the website. We also use IP addresses in the aggregate to track traffic so that we can evaluate and improve the website.
findings.rationale: The policy does not explicitly mention sharing IP addresses for advertising purposes with third parties.
